method: capstone-vm run in one guest boot per set; rounds and ticks are the launcher's counters under CAPSTONE_DELEGATE_STATS=1 (rdtime wall time at 10 MHz, no icount, host shared with other work); the contract is run-signals.py with a 30 s timeout per mode; libc-test is run-libc-test-delegated.py with the SDK built from this commit
notes: a review of the first implementation added five modes (wait-pid, rt-burst, jump-deep, waitinfo, inherit-start) and fixed what they found: positive-PID waits poll so a handler runs while the child lives, every published event holds a domain slot until SIGDONE, the trampoline sets backpressure before the ring fills and keeps one spare record, longjmp acknowledges the handlers below its saved stack pointer, sigtimedwait output is translated before delivery, startup mirrors the inherited mask and ignored dispositions

the contract's nest and altstack modes as first written looped forever on Linux too (each handler raised the other unconditionally; the altstack mode re-entered its own setjmp); both now cross-raise once

Perl faulted at exit with the first implementation: rt_sigprocmask wrote sizeof(sigset_t) = 128 bytes of old mask where the kernel writes sigsetsize = 8; musl's sigaction hands over an unsigned long[1] around a SIGABRT installation; the abort-caught mode covers that path
